rules.sentence: While the clinical presentation of symptomatic CCMs varies by location, the most common clinical manifestations are seizures (50%), intracranial hemorrhage (25%), and FND without radiographic evidence of recent hemorrhage (25%).
A review by Ene and colleagues found that the most common presentation of CCMs was seizures at an average of 40.6% of CCM cases.
Supratentorial lesions are most commonly present with seizures, whereas FND or ataxia is the most common presentation in patients with infratentorial lesions.
Between 6% and 65% of patients are asymptomatic and diagnosed incidentally on brain MRI.
